documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration Of Audited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026
Disclosure Of Information Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015, Reply To Clarification Sought On Spurt In Volume Of Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited Shares
Clarification sought from Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported stellar operational and financial performance for the fiscal year 2025-26, achieving a highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT (112% capacity utilization) and record annual production levels for diesel, petrol, and LPG. The company's gross refining margin (GRM) for the full year stood at $9.2 per barrel, outperforming the Singapore benchmark, driven by optimized crude sourcing, improved distillate yield, and enhanced energy efficiency. Management highlighted comfortable debt levels with a net debt-equity ratio of 0.09 and announced a total dividend of INR62 per equity share for the year. Moving forward, the company is progressing on key growth projects including Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS and retail outlet expansion, while remaining focused on operational reliability and capital discipline. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported its Q4 FY25 and full year financial and operational performance, highlighting resilient capacity utilization and successful energy efficiency improvements.

guidance.claim: The maintenance CAPEX for the next two years is projected to be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year.
guidance.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

demand_outlook.claim: Motor Spirit (MS) in the southern market has a shortfall where production is less than demand, with a shortfall close to 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has all approvals in place for the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project, and project execution has started in full swing.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: The retail outlet endeavor involving 300 licenses has started, and commissioning will be seen during the financial year 2026-27.
capex_expansion.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

capex_expansion.claim: The Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project cost is INR1,600 crores and the retail outlet project cost is INR400 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores. The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the Cauvery basin refinery project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

margins_costs.claim: The gross refining margin for quarter 4 was $13.75 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: The core GRM for the fourth quarter was $10.3 per barrel.
The Gross Refining Margin (GRM) for the full year 2024-25 was $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: For Q4 FY25, the GRM was $6.22 per barrel compared to $7.7 per barrel in the same quarter of the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel. Again, if I compare the previous year same quarter, it was $7.7 per barrel, but if I compare it to Singapore benchmark, which was only $3.1 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported operating expenditure (net) of 1,085 crore in 2022-23, 1,215 crore in 2023-24, and 945 crore in 9M 2024-25.
The company reported CST under recovery of 463 crore in 2022-23, 361 crore in 2023-24, and 246 crore in 9M 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, equivalent to 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: In quarter 4, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The new LOBS unit will add a capacity of 250,000 KTPA in Group 2 and Group 3.
orders_capacity.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of its installed capacity during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity and this must be seen with respect to the turnaround that has happened during the year and if you take that into consideration , you will find that this performance is quite comparable to the previous year's performance where CPCL clocked 111% capacity utilization

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput for Quarter 4 was 2.974 MMT, which is 113% of the installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity ratio stands at 0.18 at a gross level compared to 0.39 last year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Gross borrowings are INR1,900 crores, while net borrowings stand at INR973 crores with a net debt ratio of 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores. If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, for the first time, CPCL paid an interim dividend, and we are happy to announce that in addition to the interim dividend of INR8 per equity share of INR10 each, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity position as of March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: When I turn to leverage position, the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt at an absolute level stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as of March 31, 2025, compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as of March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share, which is 50% of the face value for the current year.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

risks_headwinds.claim: Uncertainties due to logistical constraints and volatility of crude oil prices pose challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Uncertainties due to the volatility of crude prices pose a challenge to the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company reported exchange variation (gain)/loss of 523 crore in 2022-23, 72 crore in 2023-24, and 122 crore in 9M 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: The company will spend INR2,000 crores on the LOBS and retail outlet projects over 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The normal annual capex can be assumed to be another INR500 crores every year.
management_commitments.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL is committed to developing new schemes on energy efficiency, bringing the fuel and loss reduction roadmap further lower, and developing enhanced production of value-added products.
management_commitments.quote: To summarize the physical performance, we are committed to develop new schemes on energy efficiency, take the fuel and loss reduction roadmap further lower and then develop enhanced production of value-added products as well going forward.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
